independence_declaration.statement: I (domain-reviewer) authored no implementation in the DG1 candidate. backend-workflow-engineer wrote the round-15 repairs for F-DG1-136 and F-DG1-217 (T-DG1-BE16, commit 22f3054). qa-verifier raised both findings in round 14; I did not. I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-15 record, and I read none of them. The only earlier-round material I read was my own role's round-14 record and scripts, to reuse their procedures, plus the F-DG1-136 and F-DG1-217 entries in findings.json and the round-14 qa install log, to see how the read-only pnpm store was copied.

Check HEAD, that the repository is not shallow, and the recomputed candidate ID, both in the repository and in a full disposable clone checked out at the freeze commit f27b5a6. Check that HEAD (c7edc14) differs from the freeze commit only by candidate-excluded metadata.

checks_run.environment: repo /home/user/My-owns at c7edc14; disposable clone $TMPDIR/rev at f27b5a6; Node v24.21.0
checks_run.expected: candidate_id sha256:76d8b304…7846 (391 files) in the repo and in the clone; not shallow; HEAD = freeze commit + candidate-excluded metadata only
checks_run.actual: HEAD is c7edc144b336…, not shallow. Both computations give sha256:76d8b3049d22d414a4c036bd3dd1af6e0c3609baedb096e2d2ecf4180bf07846 with 391 files. f27b5a6 is an ancestor of HEAD, and f27b5a6..HEAD touches only the round-15 assignments, the candidate manifest (whose source_commit is f27b5a6) and stages.json, all of them excluded from the candidate. HEAD is not the freeze commit, but the candidate ID (the binding identity) matches. This follows the same convention as rounds 13 and 14: the assignment names f27b5a6 as the freeze commit, and c7edc14 is the metadata commit that freezes it.
